name: Suspicious Eventlog Clearing or Configuration Change Activity
description:
Detects the clearing or configuration tampering of EventLog using utilities such as "wevtutil", "powershell" and "wmic".
This technique were seen used by threat actors and ransomware strains in order to evade defenses.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
query: ((process.executable:*\\wevtutil.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wevtutil.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*clear\-log\ * OR *\ cl\ * OR *set\-log\ * OR *\ sl\ * OR *lfn\:*))) OR ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\powershell_ise.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND ((process.command_line:(*Clear\-EventLog\ * OR *Remove\-EventLog\ * OR *Limit\-EventLog\ * OR *Clear\-WinEvent\ *)) OR (process.command_line:*Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession* AND process.command_line:*ClearLog*) OR (process.command_line:*Diagnostics.EventLog* AND process.command_line:*Clear*))) OR (((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\powershell_ise.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wmic.exe)) AND process.command_line:*ClearEventLog*) AND (NOT ((process.parent.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe)) AND process.command_line:*\ sl\ *)))
